    Welcome to Racket Hub

    Our adult programs are designed for players who want to learn properly, improve efficiently, and actually enjoy playing tennis. Classes are grouped by playing level, so you’re always training with players at a similar stage.

    Beginner (NTRP 0-2.0) Group Lessons

    Available at: Maryvale

    You are: new to tennis or returning after a long break. Little to no rallying experience.

    What can you expect: A supportive, structured environment with lots of repetitions, clear progressions, and zero pressure. By the end of the session, players are rallying, serving, and playing points with confidence.

    Book

    Intermediate (NTRP 2.5-3.5) Group Lessons

    Available at: Maryvale

    You are: a player who can rally consistently, serve with control, and understand basic match play.

    What to expect: Higher-intensity drills, tactical coaching, and structured point play to help you compete confidently in real matches.
